cards.target: As providências tomadas lograram êxito.
cards.english: The measures taken were successful.

cards.target: A que se deve tamanha indignação?
cards.english: What is the reason for such indignation?

cards.target: Tal assertiva, conquanto provocativa, merece consideração.
cards.english: Such an assertion, although provocative, merits consideration.

cards.target: Vossa Excelência está convidada para a cerimônia.
cards.english: Your Excellency is invited to the ceremony.

cards.target: Alhures, a situação pode ser completamente diferente.
cards.english: Elsewhere, the situation may be completely different.

cards.target: Deveras, a situação exige uma resposta imediata.
cards.english: Indeed, the situation demands an immediate response.

cards.target: Dessarte, cumpre-nos reavaliar nossas prioridades.
cards.english: Therefore, it behooves us to reassess our priorities.

cards.target: Quer-me parecer que as coisas estão mudando.
cards.english: It seems to me that things are changing.

cards.target: A consecução dos objetivos requer empenho coletivo.
cards.english: The achievement of the objectives requires collective effort.

cards.target: Não há de ser fácil convencê-los do contrário.
cards.english: It won't be easy to convince them otherwise.

cards.target: Via de regra, as reuniões acontecem às segundas-feiras.
cards.english: As a rule, meetings take place on Mondays.

cards.target: Quando menos se espera, a vida nos surpreende.
cards.english: When you least expect it, life surprises you.

cards.target: À mingua de recursos, o projeto foi suspenso.
cards.english: For lack of resources, the project was suspended.

cards.target: Conforme aduzido anteriormente, os fatos corroboram a alegação.
cards.english: As previously argued, the facts corroborate the claim.

cards.target: O açaí é sagrado para quem é do Norte.
cards.english: Açaí is sacred for people from the North.

cards.target: O bumba meu boi é uma manifestação folclórica encantadora.
cards.english: Bumba meu boi is a charming folklore manifestation.

cards.target: Em que pese o argumento contrário, mantenho minha posição.
cards.english: Despite the opposing argument, I maintain my position.

cards.target: Ao revés do que se supunha, os indicadores melhoraram.
cards.english: Contrary to what was assumed, the indicators improved.

cards.target: Antes que eu me esqueça, tem um recado pra você.
cards.english: Before I forget, there's a message for you.

cards.target: Mormente no que se refere à questão ambiental, urgem medidas.
cards.english: Especially regarding the environmental issue, measures are urgent.

cards.target: A par e passo com as transformações sociais, a legislação evoluiu.
cards.english: In step with social transformations, legislation has evolved.

cards.target: Quando eu o vir, darei o recado.
cards.english: When I see him, I'll give him the message.

cards.target: Jamais olvidarei o que fizeste por mim.
cards.english: I shall never forget what you did for me.

cards.target: Tirante algumas exceções, o resultado foi satisfatório.
cards.english: Apart from a few exceptions, the result was satisfactory.

cards.target: Descabe, no caso, qualquer tipo de penalidade.
cards.english: In this case, any penalty is uncalled for.

cards.target: Abster-me-ei de tecer comentários sobre o ocorrido.
cards.english: I shall refrain from making comments about what occurred.

cards.target: É mister que se revejam os procedimentos adotados.
cards.english: It is necessary that the adopted procedures be reviewed.

cards.target: Conquanto pareça contraditório, ambas as afirmações são verdadeiras.
cards.english: Although it may seem contradictory, both statements are true.

cards.target: A par das dificuldades enfrentadas, manteve o otimismo.
cards.english: Despite the difficulties faced, he maintained his optimism.

cards.target: O debate em apreço reveste-se de suma importância.
cards.english: The debate in question is of the utmost importance.

cards.target: Sobremaneira preocupante é a taxa de desemprego entre jovens.
cards.english: Particularly worrying is the unemployment rate among young people.

cards.target: O Maracanã é um templo sagrado para o torcedor brasileiro.
cards.english: Maracanã is a sacred shrine for the Brazilian fan.

cards.target: É de bom alvitre que se consultem todas as partes envolvidas.
cards.english: It is advisable that all parties involved be consulted.

cards.target: Destituído de qualquer vaidade, aceitou a crítica com humildade.
cards.english: Devoid of any vanity, he accepted the criticism with humility.

cards.target: Houvera por bem consultar os especialistas antes de prosseguir.
cards.english: He saw fit to consult the experts before proceeding.

cards.target: Consoante o regulamento, os participantes devem se inscrever previamente.
cards.english: In accordance with the regulations, participants must register in advance.

cards.target: A língua é viva, e como tal, está em constante transformação.
cards.english: Language is alive, and as such, is in constant transformation.

cards.target: Aventa-se a possibilidade de uma fusão entre as empresas.
cards.english: The possibility of a merger between the companies is being raised.

cards.target: Em última instância, a responsabilidade recai sobre todos nós.
cards.english: In the final analysis, the responsibility falls on all of us.

cards.target: Ante o exposto, dá-se por encerrada a presente deliberação.
cards.english: In view of the foregoing, the present deliberation is hereby concluded.

cards.target: Fora mera coincidência ou havia algo mais por trás daquilo?
cards.english: Was it mere coincidence, or was there something more to it?

cards.target: Decerto, a contribuição dele foi indispensável ao sucesso do empreendimento.
cards.english: Surely, his contribution was indispensable to the success of the venture.

cards.target: A complexidade da língua portuguesa reside justamente em suas sutilezas.
cards.english: The complexity of the Portuguese language lies precisely in its subtleties.

cards.target: Donde se conclui que a premissa inicial carecia de fundamento.
cards.english: From this we conclude that the initial premise lacked foundation.

cards.target: As nuances do idioma só se revelam com a prática constante.
cards.english: The nuances of the language only reveal themselves with constant practice.

cards.target: A eloquência de suas palavras dissimulava a fragilidade de seus argumentos.
cards.english: The eloquence of his words concealed the fragility of his arguments.

cards.target: Nesta quadra da vida, a experiência vale mais que a teoria.
cards.english: At this stage of life, experience is worth more than theory.

cards.target: Ledo engano seria supor que o problema está resolvido.
cards.english: It would be a foolish mistake to assume the problem is solved.

cards.target: No afã de resolver tudo rapidamente, cometera erros graves.
cards.english: In the eagerness to resolve everything quickly, he had made serious errors.

cards.target: À guisa de exemplo, citemos o caso da reforma tributária.
cards.english: By way of example, let us cite the case of tax reform.

cards.target: Por tudo quanto foi dito, resta-nos apenas agir.
cards.english: For everything that has been said, it only remains for us to act.

existing_tips: Mesoclisis with 'se': far-se-á – literary future with reflexive pronoun.
Luiz Gonzaga ('Gonzagão') is the king of baião music.
